title: Annual Price per Covered Unit by Equipment Type — Extended Equipment Warranty Plans Rate Card
content:
Rate card of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans. The figure at the crossing of an equipment type and a tier is the annual price for one covered unit of that type on that tier, in USD.

| Equipment type | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Parts Protection Plan | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Compressor Coverage Plan | Major Component Protection Plan | Total Equipment Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rooftop unit | 0 | 320 | 640 | 890 | 1280 | 1980 |
| Split system | 0 | 185 | 360 | 480 | 690 | 1060 |
| Heat pump | 0 | 210 | 410 | 540 | 780 | 1180 |
| VRF system | 0 | 460 | 920 | 1320 | 1880 | 2850 |
| Air handler | 0 | 260 | 520 | 700 | 1020 | 1560 |
| Chiller | 0 | 2400 | 4800 | 7200 | 10400 | 15800 |
| Boiler | 0 | 820 | 1650 | 2200 | 3100 | 4700 |
| Cooling tower | 0 | 690 | 1380 | 1850 | 2650 | 4050 |
| Pump | 0 | 120 | 240 | 320 | 460 | 700 |
| Exhaust fan | 0 | 70 | 140 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Makeup air unit | 0 | 340 | 680 | 940 | 1340 | 2050 |
| Computer room unit | 0 | 540 | 1080 | 1560 | 2240 | 3400 |

## Reading the card

- Every price is per unit and per year of cover, and belongs to the tier in whose column it stands.
- The Manufacturer Warranty Registration column carries 0 for every equipment type.
- An exhaust fan carries a price on the Parts Protection Plan (70 USD) and the Parts & Labor Protection Plan (140 USD) and 0 on the Compressor Coverage Plan, the Major Component Protection Plan and the Total Equipment Protection Plan.

## Card lookups on hypothetical unit lists

- Two rooftop units and one air handler on the Parts & Labor Protection Plan read off the card as 640 USD, 640 USD and 520 USD per year.
- One chiller on the Major Component Protection Plan reads off as 10400 USD per year; the same chiller on the Total Equipment Protection Plan reads off as 15800 USD.
- A pump on the Compressor Coverage Plan reads off as 320 USD per year, and a computer room unit on the same tier as 1560 USD.
